source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection, 38 lines of inferior alveolar nerve block anesthesia with 2% lidocaine, distal incision, removal of soft resistance, loosening of the teeth and extraction of the affected teeth, routine scraping of the extraction socket, reduction of the extraction socket, and suturing to stop bleeding . In the 28th line, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was performed, the gums were separated, the teeth were straightened and loosened, and the affected teeth were extracted. The extraction socket was scraped and repositioned regularly, and cotton ball compression was used to stop bleeding.
